name: mastery
description: Mastery — the Long Watch's counterpart to Wildblood mutation and Ascendant chrome. Eight trainable disciplines (body, movement, senses, mind, combat, pain, breath, will) on a body that is never modified, because the rule the whole system is built on is that a Long Watch veteran must not look supernatural on inspection: no paper-doll entry, no appearance note, nothing an examine can see. Two limiters, on two different axes. A REPUTATION gate decides what an instructor will teach you — an NPC flagged `mastery_instructor` refuses in prose that never names reputation, a tier or a flag, the same convention the mutagen gate follows. A PURITY CAP decides how far any discipline can reach: every installed augment and every point of mutation expression lowers the ceiling, floored at 10 rather than 0, because chrome does not make discipline impossible, it makes mastery impossible, and the difference between those two sentences is the fiction. Rank is stored RAW and the cap applies on READ, so pulling chrome back out returns exactly what you earned — baking the reduction in would be unrecoverable, which is the lesson docs/systems-mutations.md already paid for once. An instructor raises the CEILING; being hit raises the number, so there is deliberately no training dummy. Storage is two per-player runtime tables hydrated in one query inside the existing login batch and read from memory thereafter (sync by contract — the swing seam may not query), with a coalesced 1m flush and lazy decay computed at hydrate rather than by any tick. The Senses and Mind disciplines complete the set. SENSES is Blind Fighting, and it deliberately does NOT answer `visibility.perceive` as its own design doc prescribed: that hook hands every handler the same original arguments and keeps the last answer, `plugins/flashlight` already answers it, and mastery sorts after — so a second opinion would REPLACE a torch's boost rather than compose with it, and a carried light would stop working because its owner got good at fighting. It rides the swing seam instead, on the one number that matters, and the engine now hands the outgoing ctx the PERCEIVED darkness penalty so the only thing a contributor can do is give back a share of what the dark took, never add anything in a lit room. MIND is Fear Discipline on `registerSanityResistor`, whose header already named it as that seam's first customer; it resists what you WITNESSED and never what you did to yourself, by an allow-list that fails closed, because a Fear Discipline that softened drugs and botched splices would be 'take less sanity damage' — a flat passive on the one resource with no other defence.

train.note: Surfaced by the declaration-only specialized action registered under requiredFlag mastery_instructor, so examining an instructor advertises TRAIN.

ticks.what: coalesced dirty-gated flush of player_reads / player_disciplines / player_purity, and banking of fights that went quiet
stance stamina drain + lazy expiry, and composure decay out of combat

extensionPoints: player_flags.lw_arc — the oath. No instructor teaches below slot 10 (the Long Watch rite), whatever an instructor's authored rep_required says. Stated once in index.js for the same reason MIN_INSTALL_TIER is stated once in plugins/augments: an instructor authored without it would be a way to skip the commitment. It gates TEACHING, never a rank already earned.
npcs.flags.mastery_instructor — { disciplines: [...], max_rank: n, rep_required: n }
MASTERY_TEACH action — the authored (VINE) route to opening a discipline
registerSwingContributor (server/engine/combat.js) — the seam Read, every technique, and Blind Fighting ride
registerSanityResistor (server/engine/condition.js) — Fear Discipline, registered under owner 'mastery'
swing ctx `darkness` (outgoing only) — the perceived to-hit penalty from darkness, handed over so a contributor can cancel part of it and can never invent a bonus in a lit room
